verdict.rationale: HubSpot exposes broad REST APIs (contacts, custom objects, webhooks) and even an official MCP server giving AI agents read/write CRM access, showing meaningful API parity for core CRM operations. However, no evidence confirms full UI-API parity for AI/agent features, reporting builders, sequences, or workflow automation, and openapi/llms.txt discovery probes returned 404s, suggesting incomplete or fragmented API surface documentation.
